name: ESP8266 ESP-01 Wi-Fi Transceiver
description: Compact 8-pin Wi-Fi serial module allowing any Arduino board to connect to 2.4GHz wireless networks via AT commands.
realWorldAnalogy: Compact 8-pin Wi-Fi serial module allowing any Arduino board to connect to 2.4GHz wireless networks via AT commands.

hazards: Module operates strictly at 3.3V. 5V on VCC or RX will damage the chip without level shifter.
safety.childSafeAlternative: Use ESP32 DevKit or USB cable communication for beginner wireless experiments

wiringGuidance: Must be powered by a dedicated 3.3V supply (Uno 3.3V pin cannot provide the 200mA Wi-Fi transmit current spikes). Use 1k/2k resistor divider on RX line.
commonMistakes: Connecting ESP-01 VCC directly to Uno 5V—this burns out the radio chip instantly!
Leaving the CH_PD / EN pin floating (it must be pulled HIGH to 3.3V).

miniExperiment.title: AT Communication Ping
miniExperiment.circuit: 3V3 and EN to 3.3V supply, GND to GND, TX to Pin 2 (SoftRX), RX through divider to Pin 3 (SoftTX).
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: ESP-01 responds with 'OK' in the Serial Monitor.
